How often should I detail my car in a rainy climate like Seattle?





In Seattle’s wet, grime-heavy climate, wash and protect your exterior every 2–3 weeks and schedule full detailing about every 3 months, increasing frequency if you park outside or drive daily.
Why Seattle’s Rainy Climate Requires More Frequent Detailing
